name: Crate
author: Diego 🥷🏻
summary: The Crate mark on the QS Bar: now playing, transport and Crate's equalizer, shown while Crate is installed.
description: The Crate mark on the QS Bar, shown only when Crate is installed. Playing bars and an artist/title ticker follow the logo. Its panel is drawn to Crate's own player spec: now playing with an all-caps ticker, the 1 px glow beams, the spectrum play button, Crate's equalizer (Smart, Genre, Adaptive, presets, the band chart). Part of Crate for Ryoku.
tagline: Now playing, transport and Crate's equalizer on the QS Bar.
